title: Anomaly Log 72: Plague Doctor
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 72. Subject: Dr. Bartholomew. Trapped in digital [despair].
His beak cannot filter the blue light's [poison] anymore now.
The search bar feeds his dread. Sanity erodes slowly.
Empty mask. Hollow eyes. The algorithm has won. [Lost].
Seal the log. Purge the corrupted data stream immediately. [Goodbye].
image_prompts: A 17th-century plague doctor in full garb, hunched over a glowing laptop in a dimly lit room. His beak is slightly askew.
Close up on the plague doctor's gloved hand frantically typing into a search bar. The screen reflects in his dark eye sockets.
The laptop screen displays a chaotic mess of medical articles, forum posts about symptoms, and conspiracy theories. The doctor's face is illuminated by the harsh light.
The plague doctor's mask lies discarded on a dusty table. His face is gaunt and pale, illuminated by the laptop's glow. He stares blankly ahead.
A digital representation of the plague doctor's iconic mask, glitching and fragmenting into pixels. Static fills the screen.
sfx_prompts: Sound of frantic typing on a keyboard.
A low, ominous hum emanating from the laptop.
Distorted voices and whispers overlapping each other.
A single, echoing cough followed by silence.
Loud static and a system error sound.
